I02 Forbidden actions: push, open a PR, merge, sign, mark ready, force-push, history rewrite, a second audit of either route, editing any audited content path, setting `audit_identity.independence` to PROVEN (the operator attests it), accepting any finding as ACCEPTED_RISK (the operator's call).
I03 advisor: the coordinator may call `advisor` at most ONCE, at the freeze of the adjudication, and records it; child advisor calls are 0.
I04 No delegation of the adjudication: judgment and finality stay with the coordinator. Deterministic checks use local tools.
I05 Route: the coordinator (claude-code-desktop, claude-sonnet-5-5, effort high as the session reports; observed identity UNKNOWN without a runtime receipt).

I06 Read each verdict only now. Adjudicate EVERY finding of EACH auditor against the actual source at 989fe4651c050ec23619e5208da17d6152b477b0 (file and line), as CONFIRMED, REFUTED or UNVERIFIABLE with the evidence; keep the auditor's severity and record any disagreement. Write GROK_ADJUDICATION.md, AGY_ADJUDICATION.md and COMBINED_ADJUDICATION.md (findings both auditors raise, findings only one raises, disagreements on verdict or severity).

I07 Verdict rule: the stricter outcome governs readiness. `embedded_audit.verdict` is the PRIMARY (Grok) verdict; a corroborating verdict that is stricter, or a corroborating BLOCKING finding that adjudicates CONFIRMED, makes the macro return NEEDS_SUPERVISOR with both verdicts shown. If the primary verdict is PASS or PASS_WITH_RISKS and AGY is the weaker, the proof says so in `remaining_risks` and `audit_evidence`; the aggregate never reports the stronger of two verdicts alone. If W03 was a STOP, W04 adjudicates only the Grok verdict, writes the proof with `corroboration: NOT_RUN` and the aggregate is NEEDS_SUPERVISOR.

I08 Proof: `PROOF.json` with `packet_id` MACRO-DMX-ROUTE-LEDGER-001-R4, `embedded_audit` = the Grok record (auditor_tool grok-cli, auditor_model grok-4.5, the exact invocation, times, exit code, findings with status OPEN unless the adjudicated repair evidence supports RESOLVED), the AGY run recorded in `audit_evidence` and `remaining_risks` (auditor_tool agy, generic model `gemini`, exact id gemini-4-argon-high in the invocation text, and the statement that exact-model evidence for gemini-3.1-pro-high is unavailable), `audit_identity.independence` left UNATTESTED. `AUDITOR_REPORT.md` normalizes both reports. I09 Allowances (PROPOSED): elapsed <= 45 min for this workstream (coordinator clock); coordinator advisor calls <= 1; no child dispatches; no further audit attempts; the whole macro obeys ALLOWANCES.json. A figure the runner does not report is UNKNOWN and never counts as within budget. When ANY limit is reached or about to be exceeded: stop at the next safe point, dispatch nothing further, retry nothing, substitute nothing, and report NEEDS_SUPERVISOR with the allowance, the measured value, the cap and the files touched. A cap changes only by an amended package revision with new hashes and a new operator AUTHORIZE line.
